summary: Refactor SearchableMixin to register session-level events and ensure [Post, Comment] indexing
issues_found: Event listeners were bound to a specific model instead of being registered at the session level
No centralized API for registering event listeners across SearchableMixin subclasses
Tests did not verify multiple models using the mixin
fixes_applied: Implemented SearchableMixin.register_listeners(db) to register session-level listeners
Event handlers are registered on the session class and use isinstance(obj, SearchableMixin) to filter objects
Added tests verifying Post and Comment are indexed and User (non-searchable) does not affect indexing
Added small in-memory index helper for tests (module-level ops list) to validate behavior
Added scripts (run_test.sh, run_test.bat, run_tests.py) and Dockerfile to reproduce tests and logs
Centralized registration is idempotent (won't double-register listeners)

contract_changes.indexing_api: No changes to public contract of add_to_index/remove_from_index: they are static methods used by the mixin. They return nothing; tests rely on side-effects recorded in an in-memory list.
contract_changes.error_modes: No regression or new error modes introduced. The session-level listeners are idempotent and safe to call once in app initialization. A rollback clears pending changes.

files_created_or_modified.models.py: Refactored SearchableMixin, added register_listeners and test-friendly in-memory index ops
files_created_or_modified.test_search_events.py: Tests for Post, Comment, User verifying indexing behavior
files_created_or_modified.README.md: Explains the bug and new centralized listener registration
files_created_or_modified.run_test.sh / run_test.bat / run_tests.p: Test runners for Linux/macOS and Windows, and Python wrapper to auto-detect platform
files_created_or_modified.logs/test_run.log: Generated by running tests in this environment (see repo)

notes: Tests executed in this environment; passed. If you change the search implementation to use a real external index, modify add_to_index/remove_from_index to integrate with that API and update tests to mock or stub it.
